title: Public Alert No. 033/2025 – Alert on the Sale of Counterfeit Cialis Tablet 20mg in Nigeria
summary: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit Cialis (tadalafil) 20mg tablets found in Abuja, sold at about ₦8,000 per pack versus ₦55,000 for the genuine product. The fake bears NRN 4464 and lot E3242401, unlike the genuine NRN 04-5196, lot D636431.
